page.layout: Two printed columns side by side. Left column: index entries from "D,Basilius" through "Charidemus", with the letter C as a heading line. Right column: index entries from "Charisij locus" to "Cicero", ending at "Co-". Running head at top centre.; One column of index entries on the right, from top to bottom. At the lower left, one line of the column to the left of it, level with the last entries.

main_text.l: Catonis locus,230.15.responsum ad arrofas à foricibus caligas, 287.5
Cicero unicè delectatus Theophrasti scriptis. 85.2. Theophrastum vocat amicum suum. 85.4. Theophrasti morientis auerelam refert. 86.3. Co-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "105.5" (printed as "105.f"); the Greek of "Cassandra" (ἀλφινφάγ), "χαρίνεια" and "Ὕψα", and "Χαρίνεια ἰλλώ" are uncertain; "auerelam" is as printed and may be a printing error for querelam. The large C before "Alenus" is read as an initial letter joined to the word. Greek letters follow the scan as far as legible. Lower-left line and entries as printed; Greek words copied in Greek letters. The Greek word after "quod viro conueniat" is uncertain, marked [?]. Entry "Ciceronis locus" and "emendatus" are printed in mixed roman and italic type.
